editor_notes.factual_accuracy: Special scrutiny per review request: (1) $3.36B total, $1B Nvidia tranche in mid-November, and $35B target valuation all confirmed verbatim in source-0 and source-3. The submitted article cites the $2.36B figure exclusively to TechCrunch, and cites SiliconANGLE in the same paragraph only for the investor-name list (Apollo, Citadel, 'more than a dozen other institutional investors') with no dollar figure attached to that citation. I grepped the full body_markdown for '2.26' and confirmed it does not appear anywhere in the article. The bot's claimed resolution was applied correctly and completely.
